test_vectors.execution: Not executed per explicit instruction. No build, check, formatter, compiler, test runner or commit command was run.
test_vectors.review: Manually reviewed against frozen endpoint-ron and endpoint-model contracts, ABI types, registry implementation, and prior loading and normalization modules.

groups.coverage: Empty models, unconstrained model version during semantic validation, complete immutable models, deterministic repeated calls and unchanged ABI errors
groups.expected: Valid models return Ok(()); failures preserve registry diagnostics and leave the model unchanged.

groups.coverage: Service ids 0 and u16::MAX; endpoint and error codes 0 and u32::MAX; duplicate service names/ids, global endpoint codes and service-local endpoint names
groups.expected: Boundary values are valid; duplicates fail with ConstraintViolation; endpoint and error code namespaces remain independent.

groups.coverage: Canonical method components, exact service ownership, ASCII identifier rules, case-sensitive names, reused endpoint names across services and independent name namespaces
groups.expected: Canonical distinct names are accepted; malformed or fully qualified components and service mismatches fail with ConstraintViolation.

groups.coverage: StructRef, EnumRef and StructTable in params, response, stream, unused definitions and headers; nested containers and struct fields; forward aliases and inline declarations
groups.expected: Declared references resolve; unknown references, scalar targets and wrong nominal kinds fail with ConstraintViolation.

groups.coverage: Self and mutual nominal recursion, recursive StructTable, unused self/mutual alias cycles, alias kind changes, duplicate definitions, mismatched nominal names and repeated inline declarations
groups.expected: Nominal recursion is accepted; alias-only cycles and namespace conflicts fail with ConstraintViolation.

groups.coverage: Ownership depth MAX_REFERENCE_DEPTH and MAX_REFERENCE_DEPTH + 1 at every root; alias chains at both boundaries; combined ownership/reference budgets; shallow-visit depth regression
groups.expected: The exact boundary is accepted; exceeding the shared traversal limit fails with DepthLimitExceeded.

groups.coverage: Every scalar EndpointType; NanoId lengths 0, 1 and u8::MAX; field scope, UTF-8 names, empty and duplicate fields; enum i32 boundaries, empty enums, duplicate names/discriminants and invalid identifiers
groups.expected: Valid scalar, field and enum metadata is accepted; zero NanoId length and invalid fields/variants fail with ConstraintViolation.

groups.coverage: Unused definition/role/error names; independent global error name/code uniqueness and case-sensitive error names
groups.expected: All records are validated even without endpoint references; invalid or duplicate keys fail with ConstraintViolation.

groups.coverage: Public endpoints with invalid unused roles, unknown and duplicate includes, self/mutual cycles, unknown/duplicate endpoint roles, role diamonds and chains longer than the type depth limit
groups.expected: Role DAGs are accepted without imposing the type depth limit; undeclared roles, duplicate entries and cycles fail with ConstraintViolation.

groups.coverage: HTTP token header names, invalid Unicode/control/space/colon names, ASCII case-insensitive duplicates, parsed and normalized valid recursive configuration and invalid unused reference configuration
groups.expected: Valid headers and normalized models succeed; invalid names, header collisions and unresolved normalized references fail with canonical registry errors.
